speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The refusal stays. Plain, not pleading. Livelier, and no safer at the box. I am not opening it again tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Abel has the book. No one has a part. Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day. A clean book does not pay a seam.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter is on her table. I have shut one door today. I am not shutting that one with a sentence I do not mean.
